expo.name: CrewBus Mobile
expo.description: CrewBus remote-only mobile client: pair by QR, triage inbox, approve, launch, supervise the fleet.

plugins.cameraPermission: CrewBus scans the one-time pairing QR shown by your desktop or relay (crewbus://pair). The camera is never used otherwise.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CrewBus scans the one-time pairing QR shown by your desktop or relay.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: CrewBus protects the paired device credential with biometrics.
